questions.text: When working in a group, I naturally take charge of organizing tasks and delegating responsibilities.
I remain calm and effective even when faced with tight deadlines or unexpected obstacles.
I can explain complex ideas clearly to people who may not have a technical background.
I prefer to make decisions based on data and logical reasoning rather than intuition.
I am highly aware of my teammates' emotions and try to support them when they are overwhelmed.
I find it easy to switch gears and adjust my strategy when project requirements suddenly change.
I believe that group success is more important than receiving individual credit for a task.
I am comfortable mediating disagreements between colleagues to find a middle ground.
I consistently prioritize high-impact tasks and manage my daily schedule without supervision.
I enjoy brainstorming unconventional solutions to problems that others consider 'stuck'.
I rarely overlook small errors and take pride in the precision of my final work.
I am driven to complete my work to a high standard without needing external pressure or rewards.
I feel confident presenting my ideas or progress reports in front of a large audience.
I quickly notice patterns or inefficiencies in workflows and suggest improvements.
I view negative feedback as a valuable tool for growth rather than a personal setback.
